description: Quick SEO workflow: Before a landing page goes live, put it into Claude Cowork with the keyword, offer, and audience. Then ask where the page feels thin, where intent is off, and what questions it skips. That is how you catch weak pages early. #SEO #ClaudeCowork #LandingPages #AIMarketing #ContentStrategy
transcript: I would run every SEO landing page through Claude Cowork before I even publish it. And in fact, that's what I actually do because weak pages will look great and perfectly fine to the person who actually wrote them and what knowledge they have. But drop in the page the target keyword, the offer in the audience, then ask Claude Cowork where the page feels thin, where it feels off, where the intent is off, where the headlines are too weak, the content skips questions that the reader actually cares about. You'll get a very clean output of where you're falling short. This is a very clean workflow because you get pushed back before the page ever goes live. So if you have clients, you can get pushed back on it from Claude Cowork before client ever sees it. That saves you from publishing something that looks optimized on paper but still feels empty when an actual human being goes to read.
